blurb: Larry Kanfer is a midwest based, nationally collected photographic artist. Most known for his Prairiescapes ® (Midwest landscape photography celebrating the rural lifestyles of the American heartland), he also has extensive collections of Cityscapes, International, University of Illinois, Woodlands, Tropical, Close-ups and Abstract fine art photographs.
